source_contract_topics: Electricity distribution capacity and new connections
Ofcom fixed and mobile coverage and planned deployment
NHS health infrastructure and developer contributions

source_contract_findings.electricity: UKPN and NGED maps, flexible connections, pre-application processes and Ofgem ED3 were separated. Screening, estimates and future investment rules were not converted into firm capacity, a connection offer, reinforcement commitment or energisation date.
source_contract_findings.heat_networks: Potential zoning, the future five-year pipeline, Ofgem authorisation and registration, operator and supplier roles, and 2026 metering changes were separated. No site connection, capacity, construction or supply agreement was inferred.
source_contract_findings.telecom: The January 2026 coverage snapshot, take-up, prediction methods and operator plans to 2028 were separated. National availability and planned deployment were not treated as an address-level service guarantee, order or completed installation.
source_contract_findings.education: SCAP current capacity, forecasts, planned places, pupil-planning areas, developer-funded places and capital allocations were separated. No school-place guarantee, admission right, completed classroom or opening date was inferred.
source_contract_findings.health: ICB allocations, capital routes, joint plans, primary-care expectations and developer-contribution mechanisms were separated. No premises capacity, appointment availability, funded scheme, planning permission or delivered facility was inferred.
source_contract_findings.climate_resilience: Climate scenarios, hazards, planning adaptation, flood allowances, FRA triggers, national FCERM strategy and the 2026 National Risk Register were separated. No single parcel risk score, defence guarantee, automatic refusal or completed adaptation plan was produced.
